map.NRS-2002 营养风险筛查评分。: Screen nutritional risk with the NRS 2002 tool by combining the impaired nutritional status score, disease severity score and the age adjustment.
map.📖 查看「营养风险 NRS2002 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Nutrition Risk NRS2002 User Guide"
map.近3月体重下降: Weight loss in the past 3 months
map.总分 = 营养受损(0-3) + 疾病严重程度(0-3) + 年龄≥70(1): Total = impaired nutrition (0-3) + disease severity (0-3) + age ≥70 (1)
map.需结合临床营养评估。: To be combined with a clinical nutritional assessment.
map.营养筛查：住院患者筛营养风险定是否需要营养支持: Nutrition screening: screen inpatients for nutritional risk to decide whether nutritional support is needed
map.干预决策：评分≥3 建议营养干预: Intervention decisions: a score ≥3 suggests nutritional intervention
map.随访：病情变化复评: Follow-up: reassess when the condition changes
map.项+体重下降项+进食量项；总分 = 营养受损+疾病严重程度+年龄(≥70 加 1: item + weight-loss item + food-intake item; total = impaired nutrition + disease severity + age (add 1 for ≥70); a total ≥3 means nutritional risk. Each item is scored 0-3 per the scale.
map.例1（营养受损 1+1+1、疾病 2、年龄 1）：总分 6 分，存在营养风险。例: Example 1 (impaired nutrition 1+1+1, disease 2, age 1): total 6, nutritional risk present. Example 2 (all 0): 0 points, no nutritional risk.
map.NRS2002 和 MUST 区别？: What is the difference between NRS 2002 and MUST?
map.NRS2002 欧洲通用、含疾病严重度与年龄，适合住院；MUST 英国、偏社区/: NRS 2002 is widely used in Europe and includes disease severity and age, suiting inpatients; MUST is British and leans toward community/screening use. In China, NRS 2002 is the more commonly recommended tool for inpatients.
map.评分≥3 就一定要营养支持？: Does a score ≥3 always require nutritional support?
map.提示需要营养干预，但最终由医师/营养科结合禁忌与目标决定；严重代谢紊乱者可能暂缓: It indicates that nutritional intervention is needed, but the doctor/nutrition department decides based on contraindications and goals; those with severe metabolic derangement may have it deferred.
